candidate.definition_en: A wild carnivorous mammal of the dog family, living and hunting in packs.
candidate.explanation_ar: الذئب. حيوان مفترس بيعيش في مجموعات وبيشبه الكلب بس أكبر وأشرس.

senses.definition_en: A wild carnivorous mammal of the dog family, living and hunting in packs.
senses.explanation_ar: الذئب: حيوان مفترس من فصيلة الكلبيات، يعيش ويصطاد في مجموعات.
examples: We heard a wolf howling at the moon.
He was as hungry as a wolf after the hike.
Reintroducing the grey wolf to the ecosystem has restored ecological balance.
